correctness.rationale: A strictly increasing endpoint-preserving map between finite Gödel chains preserves minimum, maximum and Heyting residual a→b=top for a≤b and b otherwise. Therefore an equation truth-value comparison depends solely on the boundary-marked weak order type of its k inputs. Every type with d interior equality blocks is realized in C_n in exactly binomial(n−2,d) ways, and all types appear in C_{k+2}; grouping failures proves the nonnegative binomial-basis polynomial and algorithm. Only strict interior permutations contribute c_k, yielding limiting failure fraction c_k/k!. If c_k=0 and another c_d positive, failure probability approaches zero but remains positive for large n. If c_k>0, binomial(n−2,k)/n^k≥(k+2)^{-k} for n≥k+2, with the trivial one-failing-tuple bound for smaller n; coordinatewise factorization of satisfaction transfers the gap to finite direct products. Independently enumerated the example x→y=¬x∨y for 2≤n≤12, confirming (n−1)(n−2)/2 failing tuples. Domain is exactly products of chains, not every finite Gödel algebra.
